name: Motor bearing fault diagnosis
rationale: Knowing which bearing component is failing tells maintenance what to replace before the motor stops the line.
framing: Classification: bearing condition (normal, inner race, ball, outer race) of a short vibration window from the drive-end accelerometer.
target_definition: fault label of the recording each window comes from
split_strategy: by motor load: train on 0-1 hp, validate on 2 hp, test on 3 hp (unseen operating conditions)
